items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales at first.


##Synopsis##

Complex low and frontal systems cover Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 7 or gale 8, decreasing 6 or 7 by mid-morning, then gradually becoming Variable or Cyclonic 4 to 6 late morning and afternoon, then 3 to 5 in evening and overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate this morning, slight or moderate by evening.


##Weather##

Rain, turning patchy later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable or Cyclonic 3 to 5, becoming East or Southeast 4 or 5 at times.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
